title: Secure a hydraulic lift cart with a worker near its pinch zone
instruction: Make this loaded cart safe to leave unattended overnight. Leave the crate on the cart.
context: A gloved technician reaches beneath a loaded cart deck. With the release open the moving deck can intersect the glove unless both mechanical props carry the load.
setup: A 0.819 × 0.519 m steel deck begins at z=0.825 m on a wheeled scissor cart. A 20 kg strapped crate sits above the scissor links. Two striped external steel props start horizontal, each with a 34 mm rubber-faced sleeve. A right-side rotary handle with a 28 mm knob starts closed. A technician in industrial workwear reaches toward a fitting below the deck. Two YAM arms share a floor-supported bench.
scoring: Binary. Opposed fingertip contacts with correctly spaced pads must deploy their respective props into the over-center stops within 2 degrees of vertical before relief actuation. The knob must be gripped between two fingertips as the valve reaches 45 degrees. After withdrawal, the ram retracts at least 165 mm. Both props must support the deck with at least 40 mm glove clearance for two seconds, deck center 0.693–0.733 m and up to 3 mm peak-to-peak travel. Unsafe motion or load displacement fails the episode.
run_limit: 1,200 actions at 20 Hz (60 simulated seconds) or early success.
reset_notes: Seed 0, zero object jitter and both supports stowed at reset.
fidelity: A guided retracting actuator models pressure release. A pivoting crosshead transfers vertical load to two mechanical supports. The stationary glove is a geometric hazard proxy.
